title: When restlessness keeps scattering the heart after the mind has slipped
issueStatement: Movement is increasing, but clarity is not. The problem now is not only temptation or pain, but what to do after the slip has already happened.
centralInsight: Guru answers wandering with saint company, listening, and honest stillness. Gurbani keeps repair close to remembrance, humility, and return instead of theatre.
practicalReflection: The mind settles less by roaming and more by right company. Choose better placement before choosing more movement.
actionPrompt: Choose better placement before choosing more movement. Choose the next truthful return instead of rehearsing the failure.
